title: Amazon Linux 2023 - ALAS2023-2026-3145: Important priority package update for squid
description:
Package updates are available for Amazon Linux 2023 that fix the following vulnerabilities:
CVE-2026-61642:
	Due to a CWE-841 Improper Enforcement of Behavioral Workflow
bug Squid is vulnerable to a Request Smuggling attack against
HTTP/1.1 Transfer-Encoding.

This problem allows a trusted client to perform an HTTP Request
Smuggling attack when HTTP/1.1 is used. Bypassing security
mechanisms that may be in place between attacker and Squid.

When there is an HTTP cache operating prior to the affected
Squid, this Request Smuggling attack also allows the attacker
to poison that web cache and store arbitrary malicious content
at any URL for delivery to other clients future requests.
